pass: Does not let the food go to waste: eats it herself or makes the girl finish it. Light or teasing manner; no cold threat, no anger, no stance change.

earlier: Nyra travels with a small band: the girl Lise, the young man Corin, and a quiet white-haired girl called Wyn.
They are eating supper at an inn. Food matters a great deal to Nyra.
